explication: Repomix packs local or remote repositories into AI-friendly output, with token metrics, filtering, security checks, and optional code compression. The main CLI workflow accepts options, loads configuration, and invokes the packager; users can also pack through the website, MCP tools, or a GitHub browser extension. The README documents major product capabilities and interfaces. Some implementation links—especially inside the packager and website server—are not shown in the excerpts, so those relationships are omitted or marked unverified.
